range(name: string, low: object, high: object) =>
    write_line("{name,-8} {low,30} {high,29}")

write_line("{"type",-8} {"minimum",30} {"maximum",29}")

range("byte", byte.min_value, byte.max_value)
range("ubyte", ubyte.min_value, ubyte.max_value)
range("short", short.min_value, short.max_value)

range("int", int.min_value, int.max_value)
range("uint", uint.min_value, uint.max_value)
range("long", long.min_value, long.max_value)
range("ulong", ulong.min_value, ulong.max_value)
range("single", single.min_value, single.max_value)
range("double", double.min_value, double.max_value)
range("decimal", decimal.min_value, decimal.max_value)
